name: cobF_mutM_island
notes: Ancestral island containing cobF (precorrin-6A synthase, B12 biosynthesis), mutM (Fpg glycosylase, oxidative DNA damage repair), and PE_PGRS33. Present in L8 and Canettii. DELETED in all modern MTBC (L1-L7, L9, L10). Coordinates are L8 reference (CP048071.1) mapped back to H37Rv; in H37Rv the region does not exist (deletion).

name: pknH_island
notes: Ancestral island with 5 intact ORFs: PE family protein, PknH-like kinase, secreted exported protein, iron-regulated EF-Tu (tuf2) homolog, NADP-dependent dehydrogenase. Present in L8, Canettii, M. decipiens. Absent in modern MTBC. Under extreme positive selection in L8 (dN/dS 29-87) before its later deletion in modern branches.

name: PPE50_ancestral
notes: L8 retains the full-length ancestral PPE50 (382 aa, protein QJF23175.1) with C-terminal SVP (Ser-Val-Pro) domain. H37Rv encodes a truncated 132-aa vestige (Rv3135). The full form is also present in M. canettii and M. bovis. Reference: D'Souza et al. 2025 (PPE50-381 form).

name: adenylate_cyclase_split
notes: Ancestral unfused adenylate cyclase homolog (MT1360 in CDC1551). Exists as a separate ORF in L8. In H37Rv, the region underwent a fusion event producing the chimeric Rv1319c gene. Presence of the split form in L8 provides evolutionary context for cAMP signaling rearrangements.

name: TbD1_region
notes: Mycosine transport locus (mmpS6/mmpL6). Deleted in modern L2/L3/L4 lineages (hence its name "TB Deletion 1" in Brosch et al. 2002). Present in L8 and Canettii. H37Rv retains it but modern "ancestral" MTBC lineages have lost it.

name: Rv3728_canettii_shared
notes: C>A SNP at position 4176813 in Rv3728. Present in 54.8% of M. canettii and in L8. Single SPDI shared between L8 and Canettii (out of 598 L8-branch markers tested against 283 Canettii strains). Signals either rare homoplasy or incomplete lineage sorting. Source: l8_results_draft.md.
